Hymn 86: How Great Thou Art
Time Signature: 4/4

This is hymn number 86 titled "How Great Thou Art" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in B-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Swedish folk melody and the lyrics were written by Carl Boberg.
